tracks.T: OVAM released token, keys [<SoT>, token], conditional query

evidence: mu = mean_i(A_i c): observation-wise one pass through SA module 15 (all 31 calls, 8 heads) = REF (SG10-B0)

connectivity_graphs.G1: mean affinity A_bar = mean_i A_i (directed; edge u -> v has weight A_bar[u, v])
connectivity_graphs.L: diagnostic only, never selected: G2 restricted to 4-neighbour edges

bottleneck: exact widest path from S_F = {c >= Q_q(c)} on the dense 4096-node graph; sources start at the largest graph weight; no pruning

operators.B3: c + Bn * (mu - c) where mu > c, else mu

normalization_frozen_from: normalization smoke job 234640 (renyi, env gen; 14 images; bottleneck statistics only): the ratio rule failed in 107 of 112 cells (non-source medians 0.004-0.083, IQR 0.003-0.061), so rank is frozen
normalization_rule: Frozen from the normalization smoke before production, from bottleneck statistics only (no segmentation score is computed). 'ratio' = B / (largest graph weight); 'rank' = empirical percentile rank over the 4096 pixels (ties averaged). Choose 'ratio' only if, for every smoke image, track, graph G1 and G2 and quantile, the non-source ratio values have IQR >= 0.05 and median in [0.05, 0.95]; otherwise 'rank'. One convention for all graphs, including L.
candidates_per_screen: {op}_{G}_q{90,95} for op in B1, B2a25, B2a50, B3 and G in G1, G2 (16 per track)
tie_order: within 0.002: B2a50 > B2a25 > B3 > B1 (closest to the reference first), then G1 > G2 (no symmetrization), then q90 > q95 (larger source set)
diagnostics: per image: seed -> REF additions (new TP, new FP, distant new FP > 16 px, separate-component new FP) with 20-bin histograms of Bn for every graph and quantile; per candidate cell, added/lost TP and added/removed FP against REF at 0.45; REF components (50 largest) with size, TP fraction, max and mean Bn
transfer: COCO-Cap: every cell at the threshold chosen for it on all of VOC-Sim; each screen's frozen cell against its reference (paired bootstrap); reported, never selected
